village:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent reusable game structure module sheet for Allrpcs, initial artwork review.
Primary request: Paint SIX separate modules, in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid on a landscape canvas, generous transparent gaps. Each object fully contained in its cell, nothing touching canvas edges.
Input images: Reference 1 is the approved art direction, material and camera target ONLY, do not reproduce its characters, UI or scenery. Reference 2 is approved foliage detail and brushwork ONLY.
Style/medium: detailed hand-painted storybook gouache, matte brush grain, charming worn rural craftsmanship. Match the wonderful pleasing detail of the approved foliage. Not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D render.
Composition/framing: all modules high-oblique three-quarter orthographic-like projection, camera sees front and right side, no horizon, negligible perspective convergence, consistent light upper left. SIX isolated cutouts on actual transparent alpha, no background wash, no ground rectangle, no labels.
Palette/materials: cream #E8D8B8 lime plaster, weathered brown #6E4B2F timber, muted ochre #D2A84D, moss #536F3C and leaf #7F9B4E, warm charcoal #1A201D for selective outlines. Rustic earth and stone, warm late-afternoon readable values, locally contained contact shadow only.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no glowing markers, no surrounding scenery, no modern objects, no dark fantasy spires, no broad cast shadows across other assets. Keep all silhouettes distinct and intact with empty alpha around them. This is reusable artwork, not a monolithic environment painting.
Subject: top row left small cream plaster and oak timber cottage with muted ochre clay tiled gable roof, chimney, simple door and shuttered window; top middle wider village meeting/store cottage with double doorway and low porch; top right modest timber market stall with ochre cloth awning and empty counter. Bottom left reusable short cream plaster timber-braced wall section; bottom middle standalone rustic door-and-frame module with stone doorstep; bottom right low timber fence section with gate. Buildings uninhabited. Maintain coherent rural architectural language.
